package.name: pimesh_depth
package.description:
Monocular depth on the GPU: Depth Anything V2 Small at 518², publishing metres on /depth and the colour frame it was inferred from on /depth/rgb. This is the pipeline's clock — ~55 ms a frame against a ~17 ms frame interval, so it keeps roughly one frame in three and drops the rest through its own one-slot mailbox.
It builds on the Pi, where it can never run, and that is deliberate rather than sloppy. depth_node, its registration and its parameters are identical on both machines; only the engine behind the DepthEngine interface is conditional — depth_engine_ort.cpp where CMake found ONNX Runtime, depth_engine_null.cpp where it did not. So the Pi builds a depth_node that refuses to start with a message saying why, which is correct for a node that machine must never run, and pimesh_bringup's test_transforms can go on asserting that every plugin string in the launch file resolves in the ament index *at both ends*. Building it only where the GPU stack exists would weaken that check on the machine where it matters least, by weakening it everywhere.
